message: The islands here float! People call them phumdis: thick mats of plants and soil drifting on the lake. The biggest patch is a national park, and a rare deer lives on it.

field_find.name: Sangai deer
field_find.note: Manipur's brow-antlered deer, at home on the floating meadows of Keibul Lamjao National Park.

alt: A wide lake dotted with rings of floating green islands, low hills behind.
